title: epic-verification.v1
description: Epic-level clarity verdict produced by harness-epic-verify. One record per JIRA Epic. Questions carry a lens (be|fe|ba) because the Epic is asked about from three angles, and each lens is posted, tracked, and answered as its own thread.

reporter_account_id.description: Usually the BA who wrote the Epic — the person the questions are addressed to, mentioned in the comment and made assignee by the handoff.

child_keys.description: Child tickets found by expansion. Inventory only — child stories are verified by harness-story-verify, not here.

verdict.description: clear = every blocker gate passes and there are no open questions. blocked = the Epic could not be read (permission/MCP), so no judgment was made.

result.description: n-a requires a note stating why the gate does not apply to this Epic.

evidence.description: The quoted Epic text the judgment is based on (empty when the section is absent).

questions.description: The exact questions that will be posted. Each one traces back to a failing gate and carries the lens it was asked from.

lens.description: be = backend/data/contract angle, fe = frontend/UX angle, ba = business/scope angle.

why.description: One line on what cannot be built, sized, or tested until this is answered.

clarifications.description: One entry per lens thread. A lens with no questions gets no entry.

state.description: drafted = comment written, not posted. skipped = the operator declined to post this lens.

handoff.description: The reporter handoff performed once per Epic when the first lens comment is posted: assign back to the reporter and move the status to a clarification state. A missing transition is recorded as skipped, never as a failure.

transition_skipped_reason.description: Why the status was left alone: no-matching-transition, preferred-status-not-available, already-in-target-status, or disabled-by-flag.
